title: Text: DET Greg Garno ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Ok, so you’ve got the start of a great tweet, but the point is you’re supposed to suggest to your captors that everything is fine while alerting your followers
So wouldn’t you need to do something like “Since March 27, my life has been pure bliss and not a thing has ruined my day.”
The point I was trying to make was that I have been tweeting like everything is alright since opening day and I can’t take it anymore
Option B was like ... “Alright, so you guys aren’t getting it. Since March 27, everything has been fine. There is nothing to see here. Also, the Tigers lost.”
Ahhhh, I see. That could work, I might just be an idiot
I should save it for an end-of-gamer
